coordinateSystem: top-left; rect = [x,y,width,height]; pivot normalized to the untrimmed frame

integration.sky: Draw opaque gradients behind the city, or use the gradient stops in the existing sky shader.
integration.tiling: Repeat cropped frame content, never the entire atlas. Display sizes are CSS pixels at 844x390.
integration.time: Loop frame = floor(elapsedSeconds * fps) % frames.length. Once: stop after frames.length/fps seconds.
integration.fog: Crossfade adjacent frames. Use a shallow horizon/depth mask to keep buildings readable.
integration.motion: Honor prefers-reduced-motion: use static weather and omit fireworks, confetti and balloon drift.
integration.depth: Birds and butterflies are ambient billboards. Apply world/depth occlusion if placed among buildings.
integration.gpu: All textures use normal source-over; disable depthWrite for translucent billboards. Keep UI above effects.
integration.memory: Each RGBA8 atlas occupies 4 MiB decoded. Load weather + ambient on demand; only load a selected firework and sky when needed.
